summary: Service dispute over preferential appointment for ST candidates; contention: applicability of Karnataka Civil Services (Unfilled Vacancies) Rules, 2001 to university posts; interpretation of Karnataka Universities Act, 2000 Sec.53-54 vs Karnataka SCs/STs Reservation Act, 1990; amendment clarifying reservation scope for universities under Sec.4(1A); university's merit-based appointment challenged as violating preferential age criteria; issue: whether backlog vacancy appointments must follow 2001 Rules; HC upheld preferential appointment for candidate within 29-40 age bracket; SC examined legislative framework and amendment history; determination whether universities fall under 'establishments in public sector' for reservation purposes; applicability of UGC regulations versus state reservation rules; final conclusion on correct mode of selection for reserved posts.
